summary: Backend now has per-principal prompt/category storage with CRUD-style methods and the frontend adds a backend-sync layer plus improved rich-text sanitization/paste handling. However, favicon generation/linking is not shown, and favorite/metadata persistence to backend appears incomplete (favorites/dates not stored and favorites explicitly derived locally). Some unrelated URL/session parameter utilities and admin-token plumbing were added without being requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Creating a prompt, editing a prompt, deleting, duplicating, and toggling favorite update the backend and then reflect in the UI.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows backend prompt type and API mappings that do not include isFavorite or date metadata; frontend mapping explicitly sets isFavorite=false and derives it from local state, which means toggling favorite is not persisted to the backend. Duplicate behavior persistence is not evidenced in the shown backend-sync wrapper (file is truncated).

missing_requirements.requirement: Prompts (including related metadata) are stored per authenticated user and round-trip reliably from backend without losing required state.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend Prompt type lacks fields for common UI metadata (e.g., isFavorite, dateAdded, dateModified). Frontend mapping fabricates dates with Date.now() and sets isFavorite to false, so this metadata cannot round-trip reliably from backend.

missing_requirements.requirement: Set the uploaded image as the app’s browser-tab favicon by generating 16x16 and 32x32 PNG assets and referencing them from frontend/index.html under /assets/generated/.
missing_requirements.reason: No diff evidence shows generated favicon PNG files or any update to frontend/index.html to reference /assets/generated/favicon.dim_16x16.png and /assets/generated/favicon.dim_32x32.png.

hallucinated_features.description: URL parameter + sessionStorage utilities (including mention of persisting an admin token) added.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any REQ; BuildRequest is about backend prompt persistence, rich-text paste preservation, and favicon generation/linking.

hallucinated_features.description: Frontend actor initialization now pulls an admin secret from URL params and calls _initializeAccessControlWithSecret.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any REQ; authentication scope specified only Internet Identity principal-based per-user storage.
